issues.display_title: Issue #1605: Fix Bug Review Photographer Modal Displays Reviewer's Portfolio Instead of Applicant's
issues.main_description_html:
Description

A critical data-fetching issue has been reported in the Featured Photographers → Review Photographer modal.

When a Support/Admin user opens a photographer's profile for review and navigates to the "Portfolio" tab, the system incorrectly loads and displays the reviewer's own virtual tours (e.g., the admin's personal GoThru portfolio), rather than the tours belonging to the photographer being reviewed.

This prevents the Support team from properly evaluating the applicant's work before approving or denying them.

Acceptance Criteria

  1. When opening the "Review Photographer" modal and navigating to the Portfolio tab, the system successfully fetches and displays the virtual tours belonging to that specific applicant.
  2. The reviewer's own personal virtual tours never appear in the portfolio list of another user.

Test Scenario (for Tester / QA)

Preconditions

  • Logged in as a Support/Admin account that itself has a non-empty GoThru portfolio (own virtual tours) — this is key to reproducing the bug.
  • At least one applicant photographer exists in Featured Photographers whose portfolio is different from the admin's (ideally with recognizable tour titles).

Scenario 1 — Applicant's portfolio loads (the bug)

  1. Go to Support → Featured Photographers.
  2. Open an applicant's Review Photographer modal.
  3. Click the Portfolio tab.
  4. ✅ Expected: The listed tours belong to the applicant (titles/links match the applicant's account), not the admin's own tours.
  5. ❌ Bug (before fix): The admin's own virtual tours are shown instead.

Scenario 2 — Cross-check different applicants

  1. Close the modal and open a different applicant's Review Photographer modal → Portfolio tab.
  2. ✅ Expected: The portfolio changes to that second applicant's tours. Two different applicants must never show the same (admin's) list.

Scenario 3 — Reviewer's own tours never leak

  1. Note the admin's own portfolio tour titles beforehand.
  2. Review several applicants' Portfolio tabs.
  3. ✅ Expected: The admin's own tours never appear in any applicant's portfolio list.

Scenario 4 — Applicant with empty portfolio

  1. Open the Review modal for an applicant who has no tours.
  2. ✅ Expected: An empty/no-tours state is shown — not the admin's tours as a fallback.

Scenario 5 — Switching tabs / reopening

  1. Within one applicant's modal, switch between tabs (Account Statistics / Profile / Location / Portfolio / Gear) and back to Portfolio; also close and reopen the modal.
  2. ✅ Expected: Portfolio consistently shows the correct applicant's tours every time (no stale data from a previous open or from the admin).

Pass criteria: Every applicant's Portfolio tab shows only that applicant's tours; the reviewer's own tours never appear for any other user.

Reference: docs/superpowers/specs/analyze-all.md — see §3 Persona D (Support/Admin) and §4 (Photographer profile & directory).

issues.display_title: Issue #1606: Fix Bug "Failed to upload avatar" Error on Photographer Profile for New Accounts
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Users with newly created accounts are unable to upload a logo/avatar on their Photographer Profile page. When attempting to drag and drop or click to upload an image into the designated area, the upload fails and triggers a red toast notification stating: "Failed to upload avatar".

User Notes & Workaround Attempt

The user suspected the account might need an initial activity trigger to initialize storage space, so they tried creating a virtual tour and successfully uploaded a 360 image to that tour. However, returning to the profile page and attempting the avatar upload still resulted in the exact same failure.

Test File Used

A standard 360 view logo (PNG/JPG) was used for the upload attempt, ruling out an obscure file type issue.

Acceptance Criteria

  1. New accounts can successfully upload an avatar/logo to their profile immediately after registration.
  2. The avatar upload process functions independently and does not require the user to create a tour or perform other actions to "unlock" or initialize their storage.
  3. If an upload fails due to validation (size/format), the UI displays a clear and accurate reason to the user.

Test Scenario (for Tester / QA)

Preconditions

  • Have (or create) a brand-new account that has performed no other activity (no tours, no uploads).
  • Open browser DevTools → Network/Console to capture the failing avatar upload request/response.
  • Have a valid avatar image ready (standard PNG/JPG within allowed size).

Scenario 1 — Fresh account avatar upload (the bug)

  1. Register a new account and go directly to Photographer Profile.
  2. Upload an avatar/logo via drag-and-drop and again via click-to-upload.
  3. ✅ Expected: The avatar uploads successfully and displays on the profile — no "Failed to upload avatar" toast.
  4. ❌ Bug (before fix): Red toast "Failed to upload avatar" appears; avatar is not saved.

Scenario 2 — No tour-creation dependency

  1. On a fresh account that has never created a tour, upload the avatar first (before any other action).
  2. ✅ Expected: Upload works without needing to create a tour or upload a 360 image first (the storage-init workaround must not be required).

Scenario 3 — Persistence after reload

  1. After a successful avatar upload, reload the profile page (and re-login).
  2. ✅ Expected: The avatar persists and is shown consistently.

Scenario 4 — Validation error messaging

  1. Attempt to upload an oversized file and an unsupported format (e.g. .bmp/.svg/.txt).
  2. ✅ Expected: Upload is rejected with a clear, accurate reason (e.g. "File too large (max X MB)" / "Unsupported format — use PNG or JPG") — not a generic "Failed to upload avatar".

Scenario 5 — Update existing avatar

  1. Upload a new avatar to replace an existing one.
  2. ✅ Expected: The new image replaces the old one successfully.

Scenario 6 — Regression on established accounts

  1. Repeat the avatar upload on an older/established account.
  2. ✅ Expected: Still works — the fix doesn't regress accounts that already worked.

Pass criteria: A brand-new account can upload an avatar immediately with no workaround; failures only occur for genuine validation issues and show a clear, specific message.

Reference: docs/superpowers/specs/analyze-all.md — see §3 Persona A (Photographer) and §4 (Photographer profile & directory).

Demo from Developer

issues.display_title: Issue #1615: Public API: get panoramas by tour key
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Add a public endpoint for FE to fetch panorama image URLs by tour key.

Endpoint

GET /v1/panoramas/public?tour_key={tour_key}&page=1&limit=20

Response

Returns paginated panoramas with:

  • id
  • thumbnail CDN URL
  • full-size image CDN URL

Notes

  • Resolves moderation_id from hosted_tours.tours using tour_key.
  • Reads panoramas from moderation.4_panoramas.
  • Does not expose filesystem paths.
  • Full image URL uses img.gothru.org format derived from panorama paths/thumbnail convention.

Commits

  • 1870599 feat(panoramas): add public listing API
  • 13683c6 fix(panoramas): use image CDN for full panos
  • 6d5cd18 docs(api): add public panoramas collection
